goals: Verify that an NGO can successfully register and obtain a unique ID.
Verify that an NGO can successfully log in to the system.
activities: Type 'Dogs queridos' into the name input field.
Type 'dogs@mail.com' into the email input field.
Type '51999999999' into the WhatsApp input field.
Type 'Porto Alegre' into the city input field.
Type 'RS' into the UF input field.
Set up an intercept for POST requests to the 'ongs' endpoint.
Wait for the 'ongs' POST request to complete.
Assert that the response status of the 'ongs' POST request is 200.
Assert that the response body of the 'ongs' POST request has an 'id' property.
Assert that the 'id' property in the response body of the 'ongs' POST request is not null.
Type the previously created ONG ID into the input field.
